ideas.title: Medicaid Fraud Investigation
ideas.description: Investigate the recent surge in Medicaid fraud cases in Minnesota and across the US
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
Who are the key players involved in the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale scheme involving multiple entities and individuals. By following the money, we can identify the key players and bring them to justice.
